changelog: - **A run CSV column named like a formula opens as text.** In the Timeline's run CSV, a column whose name begins with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` (a Pool, timetable line or rule named that way) was written as it is, so a spreadsheet opening the file could read the name as a formula. Such a column name now starts with `'`, as in the change-proposal export; every other column name and every number is written as before.
